body.en: Pulse can alleviate Charging, But changes average Flux and Throughput
Polymer can protect sidewalls, But excess causes Residue / Stop

body.zh: Bias提高Bias可清底，但可能增加Mask Loss和Damage
body.en: Bias Higher Bias can clear the bottom, But may increase Mask Loss and Damage
Do not conclude from a single cross-section
Similar Profiles can Arise from different combinations: Energy, Angle, Chemistry, Mask, Temperature.

body.zh: 边界：Defect Signature 通常不是唯一解；必须用时序、空间分布和独立量测建立证据链。
body.en: Boundary: a Defect Signature usually has no unique explanation; build an evidence chain using time sequence, spatial distribution and independent metrology.
